title: The Manual-Payment Step Added to an Auto Loans Rate, by the Borrower's Card Standing
content:
When the rate on a loan of the Auto Loans line is restated, a manual-payment step is added to it. The size of that step is read from the borrower's Personal Credit Cards account.

**0.0 points** where the borrower's card carries at least 25000 unredeemed reward points and at least 6 card purchases have posted in the last three months.

**0.05 points** where that card carries at least 5000 unredeemed reward points and at least 3 card purchases have posted in the last three months, while either those points fall short of 25000 or those purchases fall short of 6.

**0.1 points** for every other borrower.

## The three steps in a single view

| Unredeemed reward points | Card purchases posted in the last three months | Manual-payment step |
|---|---|---|
| At least 25000 | At least 6 | 0.0 points |
| At least 5000, either reading short of the row above | At least 3, either reading short of the row above | 0.05 points |
| Any other reading | Any other reading | 0.1 points |

## What the two readings are taken from

The points reading is the unredeemed reward balance standing on the borrower's active card account in the Personal Credit Cards line. The purchase reading counts purchases posted to that card over the three months ending on the day the rate is restated; it is a count of purchases, not a sum of their amounts.

## The step at the edge of each row

A card carrying exactly 25000 points with exactly 6 purchases takes 0.0 points. The same card with 5 purchases takes 0.05 points. A card carrying 4999 points takes 0.1 points whatever its purchase count.
